verdict.rationale: Community evidence mentions Unity's HUD keyboard launcher and window-management hotkeys (WIN+SHIFT+arrow), showing some keyboard-driven navigation existed, but these references are to the deprecated Unity desktop, not current GNOME-based Ubuntu Desktop. No official docs describe a comprehensive keyboard-only workflow or launcher for the present desktop environment. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of current keyboard shortcuts/launcher, evidence of full window management (tiling, switching, launching apps) without a mouse in present-day Ubuntu, independent hands-on confirmation.
